skills.description_zh:
适用场景
收到同事/客户发来的"惨不忍睹"表格：重复行、空值、前后空格、大小写混乱、日期与手机号格式五花八门，人工整理一小时起步。本技能按「清洗配置 + 原始表格」一次性完成去重、补空、格式统一与列拆分，并输出清洗报告（每一步改了多少行），让数据可追溯、结果可复核。

核心能力
去重：整行去重 / 按关键列（如手机号、订单号）去重，保留首条并记录被删条数。
空值处理：按列配置填充策略——固定值、上一行沿用（向下填充）、列均值（数值列）、标记 【缺失】。
格式统一：去首尾空格、全角转半角、大小写规整、日期统一为 YYYY-MM-DD、手机号去分隔符校验 11 位。
列拆分：按分隔符将一列拆为多列（如"省-市-区"拆三列）。
清洗报告：逐条列出操作、影响行数、丢弃/存疑数据清单，方便发给数据提供方核对。
skills.name: Excel脏数据快速清洗模板

skills.description: Paste your slow SQL and EXPLAIN output; get ready-to-run index DDL, safe query rewrites and a pre-release checklist - diagnosis first, prescription second.
skills.description_zh: One-line pitch - Treat the slow query that is killing your API like an ER patient. Paste the SQL plus EXPLAIN output and get index DDL and rewrites you can run today. Capabilities - line-by-line EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE walkthrough, index prescriptions with CREATE INDEX statements and write-amplification warnings, query rewrites (kill SELECT *, fix implicit casts, cursor-based pagination), lock and long-transaction triage, slow-log batch triage Top 5, pre-release risk checklist. When to use - slow query, query optimization, EXPLAIN analysis, index design, database tuning, API timeout, N+1 queries, deep pagination, MySQL performance, Postgres tuning. 中文版: search "慢SQL急诊室" (sql-slowquery-doctor) on SkillHub.
skills.name: Slow SQL ER Doctor

skills.description: Triage slow SQL like an ER doctor - paste your query and EXPLAIN output to get ready-to-run index DDL, query rewrites and a pre-release risk checklist.
